name: claude-inline-explain
description: Select code, press ⌘K, and ask Claude Code about it in an inline popover. Uses your local Claude Code CLI and its subscription login — never an API key.

enumDescriptions: Whatever model your Claude Code CLI is configured to use
claudeInlineExplain.model.markdownDescription: Model Claude Code uses for answers. Overridden by `#claudeInlineExplain.customModel#` when that is set.

claudeInlineExplain.customModel.markdownDescription: A full model name or alias to pass to `claude --model`, such as `claude-sonnet-5-5`. Leave empty to use `#claudeInlineExplain.model#`.

claudeInlineExplain.effort.description: Reasoning effort passed to `claude --effort`. Lower is faster.

claudeInlineExplain.claudePath.markdownDescription: Path to the `claude` executable. Leave empty to auto-detect (PATH, `~/.local/bin`, `~/.claude/local`, Homebrew, and your login shell).

claudeInlineExplain.showCodeLens.markdownDescription: Show a clickable **✨ Explain** button above the selected code. Requires `#editor.codeLens#`.

claudeInlineExplain.showInlineHint.description: Show a faded '✨ Explain ⌘K' hint at the end of the selection. The hint is not clickable, but it does not shift any lines.

claudeInlineExplain.showCodeAction.description: Offer 'Explain with Claude' in the lightbulb / Quick Fix menu (⌘.) when code is selected.

claudeInlineExplain.selectionDebounceMs.description: How long the selection must stay still before the Explain button appears.

claudeInlineExplain.popoverPosition.description: Show the popover above or below the selected code.

claudeInlineExplain.fontSize.markdownDescription: Font size of the popover text in pixels. `0` uses your editor font size (`#editor.fontSize#`).

claudeInlineExplain.fontFamily.markdownDescription: Font family of the popover text, for example `Inter, sans-serif`. Empty uses the system UI font. Code in answers always uses your editor font.

enumDescriptions: Fit the answer, up to Max Height
claudeInlineExplain.popoverHeight.markdownDescription: Height of the popover while it shows answers. You can also change it from the **↕** button in the popover. A popover that only has the question box stays compact.

claudeInlineExplain.maxHeight.markdownDescription: Largest height of the popover when `#claudeInlineExplain.popoverHeight#` is `auto`, as a fraction of the visible editor. Longer answers scroll inside it.

claudeInlineExplain.contextLines.description: Number of lines before and after the selection to send as surrounding context.

claudeInlineExplain.defaultQuestion.description: Question used when you send an empty prompt.

claudeInlineExplain.instructions.markdownDescription: Your style rules, added to **every** question. For example: `Keep it short. Use simple Indian English. Show a small example when it helps.` Unlike `#claudeInlineExplain.systemPrompt#`, this keeps the built-in prompt and adds to it.

claudeInlineExplain.systemPrompt.description: Replaces the built-in system prompt. Leave empty to use the default, which asks for concise answers.

claudeInlineExplain.allowReadOnlyTools.description: Let Claude use Read, Grep and Glob to look at other files in your workspace. Answers get better context but take longer.

claudeInlineExplain.loadClaudeCustomizat.description: Load your CLAUDE.md files, hooks, plugins and MCP servers. When off, the extension runs Claude Code with --safe-mode, which is much faster to start. Login and model selection work the same either way.

claudeInlineExplain.timeoutSeconds.description: Stop a request that takes longer than this many seconds.

claudeInlineExplain.showStatusBar.description: Show the current model in the status bar. Click it to switch models.
